name: o82380

name.description: A unique identifier (within the form) for the field. This value is not shown to the user and should NOT change once set.

maps_to.description: The name of the schema field the answer will map to. By default this will go to the "cf" field which is a "dynamic-field" list containing all answers filled out on the form (ref "gdbots:forms:mixin:send-submission").

label.description: The main text for the question/field.

description.description: A short description to better explain this field.

link_text.description: The text that will replace the token "{link}" within the label or description.

link_url.description: The URL to use for the replaced token "{link}" within the label or description.

description:
The form contains a required field identified internally as **user_email**. This field maps to the **email** attribute in the submission data. Users will see the label **“Email Address”** and a placeholder example of **you@example.com**. Beneath the label, a short description reads: “Please provide your email address for contact.”  

Because the information collected is considered **high** in terms of personal‑identifiable‑information impact, the form also includes a link to the privacy policy. The link text reads **“Privacy Policy”** and points to **https://example.com/privacy**.

reference_json.name: user_email
reference_json.label: Email Address
reference_json.description: Please provide your email address for contact.
